record.field: Regulation respecting occupational health and safety (S-2.1, r. 13, s. 205)

One tag per unnamed single-key padlock. The person handing out the padlock taps its tag and names who receives it (name, phone, employer); the return is confirmed with a second tap. The hand-out register is printed from the equipment list and carries the columns the regulation requires.
